about: What each of a project's two web apps leaves out of this template, for the triple tier: the public site and customer area (apps/web) and the staff's admin (apps/admin). nevela new copies the template once for each, without these; nevela upgrade leaves them out the same way, reading this file from the version it upgrades to. A path ending in / is a folder and everything in it. An app with one web app has everything.
